import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'legend.fontsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

# Okabe-Ito palette
C_INTRASUB = '#D55E00'
C_CORRECT  = '#009E73'
C_EXTRASUB = '#56B4E9'
C_MISSED   = '#CC79A7'
C_OTHER    = '#F0E442'

out_dir = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_18/projects/schema-dag-extraction/figures/paper'

fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4))

# ── (a) Few-NERD (NER) ──
bins_a = ['Zero\n(BCS=0)', 'Low\n(~0.5)', 'Medium\n(~0.75)', 'High\n(≥0.95)']
intrasub_a = np.array([0.0, 1.6, 10.6, 49.4])
extrasub_a = np.array([90.3, 89.9, 78.1, 30.8])
other_a    = np.array([9.7, 8.5, 11.3, 19.8])

x_a = np.arange(len(bins_a))
width = 0.55

ax1.bar(x_a, intrasub_a, width, label='IntraSub', color=C_INTRASUB, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.bar(x_a, extrasub_a, width, bottom=intrasub_a, label='ExtraSub', color=C_EXTRASUB, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.bar(x_a, other_a, width, bottom=intrasub_a + extrasub_a, label='Other FP', color=C_OTHER, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax1.set_xticks(x_a)
ax1.set_xticklabels(bins_a)
ax1.set_xlabel('BCS Bin')
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax1.set_title('(a) Few-NERD (NER)')
ax1.legend(loc='upper left', frameon=False)
ax1.annotate('ρ = 1.0', xy=(0.97, 0.97), xycoords='axes fraction',
             ha='right', va='top', fontsize=11, fontstyle='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='gray', alpha=0.8))

# ── (b) FewRel (RE) ──
bins_b = ['Zero\n(0)', 'Low\n(0.57)', 'Medium\n(0.73)', 'High\n(0.86)', 'Very High\n(0.97)']
correct_b  = np.array([85.73, 85.42, 75.70, 66.67, 52.03])
wrongtype_b = np.array([0.0, 4.17, 13.0, 20.28, 32.25])
missed_b   = np.array([14.27, 10.42, 11.30, 13.05, 15.71])

x_b = np.arange(len(bins_b))

ax2.bar(x_b, correct_b, width, label='Correct', color=C_CORRECT, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.bar(x_b, wrongtype_b, width, bottom=correct_b, label='WrongType (IntraSub)', color=C_INTRASUB, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)
ax2.bar(x_b, missed_b, width, bottom=correct_b + wrongtype_b, label='Missed', color=C_MISSED, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.5)

ax2.set_xticks(x_b)
ax2.set_xticklabels(bins_b)
ax2.set_xlabel('BCS Bin')
ax2.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax2.set_title('(b) FewRel (RE)')
ax2.legend(loc='upper right', frameon=False)
ax2.annotate('ρ = 0.954', xy=(0.03, 0.03), xycoords='axes fraction',
             ha='left', va='bottom', fontsize=11, fontstyle='italic',
             bbox=dict(boxstyle='round,pad=0.3', fc='white', ec='gray', alpha=0.8))

plt.tight_layout(w_pad=2.5)

pdf_path = f'{out_dir}/fig_error_taxonomy.pdf'
png_path = f'{out_dir}/fig_error_taxonomy.png'
fig.savefig(pdf_path)
fig.savefig(png_path)
plt.close()

import os
for p in [pdf_path, png_path]:
    sz = os.path.getsize(p)
    print(f'{p}: {sz/1024:.1f} KB')
